reference_description: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three different models, LLAMA1-7B, LLAMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B, as a function of the parameter M. The x-axis represents the variable M, with a linear scale ranging from 3 to 8, and tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis denotes perplexity, also on a linear scale, ranging from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The blue line, representing Vicuna-7B, uses triangular markers with a solid line. It begins at a perplexity of about 41.0 at M=3, trends sharply downward to about perplexity of about 35.0 when M=4, decreases slightly till it reach a minimum perplexity of about 33.0 at M=7, and increases to around 39.0 at M=8. The green line, representing LLAMA1-7B, uses circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at a perplexity of about 28.0 at M=3, reaches a minimum of around 25.0 at M=5, and increases to around 36.0 at M=8. The orange line, representing LLAMA1-13B uses star markers with a solid line. It begins at a perplexity of 20.0 at M=3, decreases to about perplexity of about 15.0 at M=6, and then increases to around 20.0 at M=8. A legend positioned near the center-right of the plot defines each line by its corresponding model name, marker shape and color. Each line has a different pattern and they do not intersect.
